contracts.detail: G_USER_N_DIRECTORIES changed from 8 (before commit b173cfca6) to 9 (after patch). Any code compiled against old headers using G_USER_N_DIRECTORIES as array bound or loop sentinel will have mismatched size when linked against new library.

g_get_user_special_dir(G_USER_DIRECTORY_PROJECTS) returns the configured path (/tmp/pca-test-projects-dir) when XDG_PROJECTS_DIR is set in user-dirs.dirs. G_N_USER_DIRECTORIES iteration includes the new slot at index 8.

conclusion.rationale: ABI_CHANGE (PCA-0001): G_USER_N_DIRECTORIES sentinel value changed from 8 to 9. This is a confirmed ABI break: any downstream code compiled against old headers and linked against the new library will have mismatched array sizes/loop bounds when using G_USER_N_DIRECTORIES. Although the enum is documented as extensible, the sentinel value change is a binary-level ABI incompatibility. SIDE_EFFECT_CHANGE (PCA-0002): Additive behavioral change (new icon for projects directory) is not breaking. However, the ABI break alone makes this patch backward-incompatible for compiled consumers.
recommended_actions: Consumer recompilation: All downstream packages using GUserDirectory/G_USER_N_DIRECTORIES must be recompiled against the new headers to pick up the correct sentinel value
XDG parsing test: Write a proper GLib subprocess test using g_test_subprocess() + G_TEST_OPTION_ISOLATE_DIRS to verify XDG_PROJECTS_DIR parsing in gutilsprivate.c
Cross-platform testing: Verify Windows (FOLDERID_Documents) and macOS (NSDocumentDirectory) fallback paths work correctly
Documentation: Note the ABI sentinel change in release notes so packagers know to trigger rebuilds of dependent packages
